widget.description: Complete button widget definition for create or full replacement. Omitted fields are dropped on replacement. No data source. Upsert defines the widget only; it neither places it nor changes existing placements.

id.description: Existing widget ID. Required when fully replacing a persisted widget; omit when creating a widget. Never invent this value. An unsaved draft widget has no ID and may be replaced by matching widget.name.

name.description: Stable widget key, e.g. "button_1". On persisted replacement, it must match the widget identified by id.

actions.description: Optional click/select interactions (navigate, run a flow, set a parameter, set a filter, record action) — the button's primary use case. Full per-type shape: _shared-widget-fields.json.

dynamicTokens.description: Optional dynamic value bindings keyed by token name. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json.

symbol.description: Optional icon shown alongside the caption.

position.description: Icon position relative to the caption, e.g. "left".

hoverStyle.description: ButtonStyle applied on hover. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json#/styleBlocks/ButtonStyle.
